question: Kharai Camels are known to mainly feed on:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mangroves**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Kharai camels **are a **unique breed **of **camel **found only in **Kutch **of **Gujarat **and feed on **mangroves **on the **island offshore**.
 
• **The Kharai camels **can **swim up to three kilometers into the sea **in search of mangroves, their primary food.
 
• People **consume their milk**, while **male calves **are **sold for economic returns**. Hence it can be **domesticated.**
 
 
• Given the **breed’s ability **to **survive both **on **land and sea**, the Kharai camel is one of the **most preferred choices **of **graziers **in the arid coastal region of Kutch.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cactus **can be **distinguished **from **other succulent plants **by the **presence of areoles**, **small cushionlike **structures with **trichomes (plant hairs), **and, **in almost all species**, **spines **or **barbed bristles **(glochids).
 
• **Joshua tree forests **tell a **story of survival**, **resilience**, and **beauty borne **through **perseverance**. They are the **silhouette **that **reminds those **of us **who live here **that **we are home**.
 
• **Brittlebush **is one of the **most common yellow-flowered silvery-gray **bushes in **lower deserts**. **Brittlebush **is **aptly named **as the **branches **are **easily snapped off **because of **brittle stems**.
